data.name: Danae
data.gender_notes: Danae is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Goddess of the Sea, Sky or Earth
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Danae was a woman of Argos, who was favored by Zeus and was given a golden rain shower as a gift. The name Danae comes from the ancient Greek word 'danaos', which means 'people' or 'race'. The name Danae carries the meaning “Goddess of the Sea, Sky or Earth” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Danae usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of the sea, sky or earth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Danae represents the divine feminine, the goddess within each of us. She embodies the power and grace of the sea, the nurturing and abundant nature of the earth, and the vastness and mystery of the sky. Danae is a reminder to embrace the divine within ourselves and to trust in the wisdom and guidance of the universe.
data.etymology: Danae belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of the Sea, Sky or Earth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Danae total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Danae is of Greek origin and has been used since ancient times. It is a name deeply rooted in Greek mythology and represents the idea of divine favor and blessing. The story of Danae is one of intense passion, unyielding loyalty, and miraculous survival. Danae's story shows us that even in the face of adversity, one can find hope and salvation through the blessings of the gods.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Danae carries with it a deep spiritual significance as it is derived from the Greek word for 'people' or 'race'. This name can serve as a reminder of our connection to the greater human family and our divine origins. Additionally, the story of Danae teaches us about the power of faith and trust in the divine. Even in the darkest of times, we can find hope and salvation through the blessings of a higher power. The name Danae can also be seen as a reminder of the importance of enduring through hardship and adversity, as Danae did, and coming out the other side stronger and more resilient.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Danae: In Greek mythology, Danae was a noblewoman who was condemned to be sealed in a bronze chamber by her jealous brother, Acrisius. God Zeus, in the form of a shower of golden rain, visited her and she gave birth to Perseus, symbolizing the power of divine grace and hope amidst trials and hardships. In Christianity, Danae embodies the faith and perseverance of a woman who, despite being imprisoned by her circumstances, remained open to the grace of God.
